title: Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, Pat McAfee roasted during Pro Football Hall of Fame speech

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, Pat McAfee roasted during Pro Football Hall of Fame speech
sources.description: From Bill Belichick to Tom Brady, nobody was safe during Adam Vinatieri's Hall of Fame speech. Pat McAfee was the butt of the raunchiest joke.
